primary_interest.quote: We want voice agents that handle the booking end to end.

use_case.quote: our customers book delivery slots and pickup appointments by phone

inference_framing.quote: We host that inference on our platform, so it's part of the same agent rather than something you'd bolt on separately.

inference_raised_by.quote: A voice agent needs a language model behind it to understand the caller and decide what to say.

competitors_inference.quote: We have a quote from Fireworks for the model side.

competitors_voice.quote: Bandwidth for our existing numbers. We've also prototyped on Twilio

decision_criteria.quote: my bigger concern isn't the rate, it's that we don't get surprised.

stated_reason.quote: the hard requirement is Germany. Customer data, including call audio and transcripts, has to stay in Germany.
